caveats: These figures were supplied in conversation from the account owner's own X analytics; this page is not a live API feed.
Annual metrics are approximate and may use different counting definitions than account snapshots.
The two follower observations are not a continuously collected historical series.
Daily reach and follower-change anecdotes have no precise day-by-day dataset.
Ten identified account nodes are now shown as historical observations; they are not a complete list of followers, not current follow verification, and not a social community graph.
